There is a window of under a second between a change and its revert, during which the agent may read what it just wrote. The watcher cannot tell an agent's write from a manual edit in a terminal. page.title: ClawOPT MCP server
page.description: Expose ClawOPT as MCP tools to external agent runtimes (Claude Code, Codex, Pi…). Each runtime is switched on separately and is off by default.
page.scopeToken: Each run gets its own token when it starts: only its hash is stored, it lasts 2 hours, it is revoked as soon as the run ends, and it never borrows anyone's login.
page.scopeReach: The token reaches only this run's agent, session, room or workflow, using the same rules as member permissions, and only the operations in the toolsets chosen below.
page.scopeNever: Users, providers, files, terminal and updates are not on the list, and there is no way to forward arbitrary API calls.
